spec.assertion: buffApply critDamagePct=20.28 targets diesel only, all applies share ONE key, stacks==1; zeroing it lowers only her total. Fails under the nearest-wrong where Intro AND Highlight crit buffs are both live (two keys, 40.56% total) or where it is scoped to allies.
Same 20.28% value as Intro, so the mutual-exclusivity assertion (single buff key) is the discriminator rather than the magnitude. Fails if both status branches are authored ungated.

In the sole-Burst-III fixture diesel provably casts (burstCast events mention her), so Intro must fire and Highlight must not; apply-count is in [FB-1, FB], proving fullBurstEnter keying. Fails under burstCast keying, interval keying, once-only keying, or if the Highlight branch is what fires.

Block must EXIST, must carry some gate, and stripping every gate makes it fire and raises her total. Fails both if the line was dropped (block absent) and if it was authored ungated (it would fire in the Intro fixture and roughly quadruple the sustained buff).

Status-grant ordering at the very FIRST Full Burst (is the status live in time for the same window's payload?) is not decidable from the prose, so the payload apply-count is asserted as [FB-1, FB] rather than exactly FB. Flagged, not pinned.
it.skip - no status-immunity primitive exists in the schema, and the trigger (part destruction) cannot occur on the partless scope-lock boss. Covered instead by the no-silent-drop assertion.

Asserts zero buffApply at 68.04 on the partless boss (inertness), AND that the line is either modeled as a block or recorded in unmodeled. Fails if the line is silently dropped, or if it was mis-keyed to a trigger that actually fires (which would be a free permanent 68.04% sustained).

apply-count > full-burst count (so not FB/burst/passive keyed) and <= her shot count (whole-picture bound); maxStacks==2 on every apply; zeroing lowers only her total. Fails under FB keying, under uncapped stacking, and under an ally-scoped target.

Exactly ONE block carries the DoT, trigger kind fullBurstEnter, target enemy, durationSec 9, interval 1, flavor sustained; zeroing atkPct lowers her total. Fails under a passive trigger (the engine appends an instance per fire and never dedups, so a passive 9s DoT multiplies) and under burstCast keying.

buffApply carries casterIdx===null and targetIdx===null (boss-held), durationSec 10, and zeroing it lowers liter AND crown AND diesel. Fails under the classic tandem error of encoding a Damage Taken debuff as a self ATK buff - teammates would be byte-identical.

Sum of all burst-slot dot atkPct is 199.63 (accepts split or merged encoding since both target the single boss from the same cast), every dot 9s at 1s interval, flavor sustained; zeroing them lowers only her total. Fails if the 181.2% stage-target line is dropped (sum collapses to 18.43) or if the DoTs are flattened into a one-shot flatDamage.

Represented-or-documented; if modeled, value must be NEGATIVE, durationSec 1, target allies with excludeSelf true, and gated. Inert in the Intro fixture; ungating makes it land on teammates and never on diesel. Fails under a positive-signed value (a team hit-rate BUFF), under a self-inclusive target, and under an ungated block.
it.skip - Mute has no primitive, so the decrement has no pool to act on; doubly inert because Mute can never be gained on a partless boss.

fixtures: PRIMARY: controlComp('diesel-winter-sweets', false) - liter B1 + crown B2 + diesel B3. helm is deliberately excluded because helm is a SECOND Burst III, which makes it ambiguous who completes the first burst chain, and that single fact selects Intro (60.19%) vs Highlight (235.03%). With diesel as the sole Burst III she provably casts her own burst (asserted via burstCast events), so the fixture is deterministically the Intro branch and every Highlight assertion is a clean inertness check backed by an ungating counterfactual for non-vacuity. SECONDARY: controlComp('diesel-winter-sweets', true) - a real two-Burst-III team, used only to assert the Intro/Highlight mutual-exclusivity invariant, which must hold whichever branch that rotation selects. 10 hoisted runs total (2 fixtures + 6 zeroing counterfactuals + 2 ungating counterfactuals). All counterfactuals locate blocks by the effect they carry (stat plus magnitude), never by slot index, so the file discriminates the kit reading rather than one authoring of it.
gaps: skill2 'Mute: Gains immunity to Noise Pollution, stacks up to 3' - it.skip: no status-immunity primitive in the effect schema; trigger (part destruction) is unreachable on the partless scope-lock boss.
burst 'Mute stacks -1 if the user is in Highlight' - it.skip: depends on the unmodeled Mute pool; nothing to decrement.

skill2 'part destroyed -> self Sustained +68.04% for 15s' - not skipped but asserted INERT (partless boss); the only live requirement is that it is not silently dropped (block present or recorded in unmodeled).

skill1 'for the first time' grant-vs-payload ordering at the very first Full Burst is not decidable from prose - flagged, and the S1c apply-count assertion is widened to [FB-1, FB] rather than pinned.
